notes: Unit tests for idempotency middleware passed successfully. Integration tests for concurrency lifecycle encountered Node.js worker thread issues on Windows. The unit tests verify: lock acquisition, response caching, payload mismatch detection, cross-tenant isolation, in-flight claim renewal, and concurrent duplicate rejection.
